newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves fall to $9.79 bln.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves fall to $9.79 bln.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves fell to $9.79 billion as of February 7, the latest date for which figures are available, on the back of payments for imported goods and services, the central bank said Monday.

Reserves dropped $42 million between January 31 and February 7. In the year to date, reserves have fallen $104 million or about 1 percent and are down 16.4 percent compared to the same time last year.
